profile.scope: Quaternius R5 body and Animated Longbow, South/East study
profile.note: Reject invalid poses; never stretch limbs or move only the hand off the string to hide collisions. Head test samples glove vertices against the head surface; it is not a universal whole-body collision solver.

method: Bow mesh drives grip and draw; hand releases at peak draw and recovers independently
presentation: Composite sprites for this diagnostic only; editable body and bow remain separate in Blender. Not a runtime equipment implementation.
